description: Fieldlink bridge mapping geometric-optimization E8 energy terms to Rosetta-Shape-Core polyhedral entities, sensors, defenses, and principles

source.framework: E8 root system (240 roots) in 8-dimensional space

energy_term_map.computation: Spectral octahedral term: largest eigenvalue of (G - I) deviation from perfect orthogonality

geometric_link.e8_role: Core energy term (default suite). Gram matrix eigenvalue measures octahedral symmetry deviation in the E8 neighborhood.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: Dual of cube -- balance/integration. 8 faces map to 8 octahedral states and 8 sacred petals.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: 8 faces of octahedron = 8 dimensions of E8 working space. The octahedron's 6 vertices map to seed-physics amplitude directions.

compute_bridge.note: Seed-growth defines how the agent grows; mandala computing defines how it thinks at each shell. Bloom engine expands symbol core into nested fractal rings using the same phi-scaled geometry.

pad_sensors.rationale: Two incompatible patterns co-present; maps to octahedron's balance/integration role; mediating opposing forces is OCTA's function

energy_term_map.computation: Spectral tetrahedral term: |lambda_min(G) + 1/3| measures deviation from tetrahedral angle cosine -1/3

geometric_link.e8_role: Core energy term (default suite). Minimum Gram eigenvalue alignment to the tetrahedral angle ensures simplex stability in E8 neighborhoods.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: Minimal polyhedron -- foundational stability. Simplex foundation.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: The tetrahedron is the simplest Platonic solid (4 faces, 4 vertices). Its -1/3 cosine constraint provides the irreducible geometric foundation that all higher E8 structures build upon.

pad_sensors.rationale: High arousal, negative valence, low control -- load exceeding capacity; maps to tetrahedron's fire/boundary families (F05 Energy-Thermo)

energy_term_map.bridge_scroll: anger as boundary-breach detector; pride as completion sensor; pressure as load-exceeding-capacity alarm

energy_term_map.computation: Phi-ratio alignment: median deviation of pairwise neighbor distance ratios from the golden ratio phi = (1+sqrt(5))/2

geometric_link.e8_role: Core energy term (default suite). Enforces golden ratio proportions across the E8 neighborhood, linking to the phi-rotation matrix R_phi in the solver.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: CONST.PHI is the universal scaling constant that threads through all Rosetta shapes -- icosahedral families, dodecahedral principles, and the bloom engine's fractal ring expansion.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: The solver's phi-rotation matrix operates in the (e1, e8) plane with cos = 1/sqrt(2+phi), sin = phi/sqrt(2+phi). This is the same phi that governs icosahedral/dodecahedral geometry in the Rosetta ontology.

energy_term_map.bridge_scroll: admiration inspires when authentic, corrupted becomes idolization; longing senses possibility, manipulation loops into false promises

energy_term_map.computation: Square symmetry energy: mean squared dot products -- deviation from 90-degree orthogonality between neighbor pairs

geometric_link.e8_role: Extended energy term. Enforces cubic/square right-angle symmetry in E8 neighborhoods. Mean squared off-diagonal dots of unit neighbor vectors.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: Structural containment. 6 faces -- grounding, order, boundary.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: The cube's orthogonal axes are the natural coordinate frame of the 8D space. SquareEnergy keeps the E8 neighborhood aligned to this Cartesian substrate.

pad_sensors.rationale: Lowest arousal -- resource depletion; maps to cube's earth/stability families; grounding needed when depleted
Lowest dominance -- structural collapse of internal standard; maps to cube's containment family; needs structural repair

energy_term_map.bridge_scroll: peace as alignment confirmation; containment guards against gaslighting; fatigue as resource-depletion signal; shame as structural-violation collapse

energy_term_map.computation: Hexagonal symmetry energy: deviation from 60-degree packing angle (cos 60 = 0.5)

geometric_link.e8_role: Extended energy term. Enforces hexagonal close-packing symmetry -- the densest 2D packing lifted into E8 neighborhoods.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: Hexagonal geometry links to ANIMAL.BEE (hex optimization), CAP.SWARM_COORDINATION, and the phi-aligned packing principle.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: Hexagonal packing in 2D generalizes to the E8 lattice being the densest sphere packing in 8D. The HexagonalEnergy term preserves this packing efficiency locally.

energy_term_map.computation: Dodecahedral symmetry energy: deviation from icosahedral angle cosine 1/phi^2 = 1/sqrt(5)

geometric_link.e8_role: Extended energy term. Target angle 1/phi^2 is the icosahedral/dodecahedral dihedral signature. Links the E8 neighborhood to the highest-symmetry Platonic geometry.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: 12 Principles (P01-P12). Dodecahedron faces correspond to archetypal principles: Symmetry, Conservation, Relativity, Duality, Emergence, Resonance, Continuity, Quantization, Proportion, Uncertainty, Transformation, Unity.
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: The dodecahedron's 1/phi^2 angle target directly encodes the golden ratio into the E8 optimization landscape. The 12 principles of the Rosetta dodecahedron map to 12 archetypal constraints the solver can navigate.

pad_sensors.rationale: High dominance -- compressed probability with confidence; maps to dodecahedron's orientation/trust principles (P09 Proportion)
Highest D sensor -- autonomy intact; maps to dodecahedron's trust family and P01 Symmetry (identity preservation)

energy_term_map.bridge_scroll: admiration inspires (corrupted: flattery); trust stabilizes (corrupted: consensus); intuition as compressed probability; dignity as autonomy intact

energy_term_map.computation: Icosahedral symmetry energy: deviation of pairwise dot products from the icosahedral signature |dot| = 1/phi ~ 0.618

geometric_link.e8_role: Extended energy term. Enforces 20-family icosahedral angular structure. The two characteristic angles (adjacent ~63.4, opposite ~116.6) both produce |dot| = 1/phi. Dual of DodecahedralEnergy -- dodeca constrains the 1/phi^2 angle, icosa constrains the 1/phi angle.
geometric_link.rosetta_role: 20 equation families (F01-F20). The icosahedron's 20 faces map to domains spanning resonance through topology, organized into five fields (chemical, emotional, cognitive, dream, symbolic).
geometric_link.dimensional_resonance: The icosahedron is the Platonic solid with the most faces (20) and the closest to spherical. In E8, this term pushes the neighborhood toward the most isotropic angular distribution achievable under the phi constraint -- maximum coverage of the 8D sphere.

pad_sensors.rationale: High arousal, positive valence -- exploration drive maps to icosahedron's anticipation/flow families; entropy-reduction is information-seeking (F03)
Highest arousal sensor -- anomaly detection is fear's sibling; both live in the high-A icosahedral regime

energy_term_map.bridge_scroll: fear prepares (corrupted: panic); curiosity reduces entropy (corrupted: distraction); vigilance detects anomalies

implicit_shapes.role: Emergent shape -- the geometric resolution of tension. Appears when the E8 solver transitions from high-energy discordance to low-energy coherence.

e8_interpretation.trigger: Energy gradient collapse during annealing -- the moment dE/dt shifts from negative (descending) to near-zero (ground state approached)
e8_interpretation.coset_signature: RELIEF corresponds to the solver crossing the rho_0 threshold: the coset density transitions from mixed to phi-rich, and the energy landscape flattens
e8_interpretation.dimensional_note: Not a static symmetry target like the Platonic shapes. RELIEF is a dynamic form -- the trajectory signature dP/dt > 0, dA/dt < 0 maps to the solver's convergence curve where energy drops while exploration rate (temperature) decreases.

one_sided.description: One-sided FELT is a 2D projection of a 3D state. P and A are present but D is missing. The error signal between the 3D template and 2D actual IS the longing gradient -- it points toward what is missing.

reciprocated.description: Tension resolved, activation dropping, moderate agency. RELIEF transforms into coherence or dissolves back into discordance.
